Sonam Wangchuk Alleges Minister Broke Promise, Ends Hunger Strike

Activist Sonam Wangchuk has ended his 21-day hunger strike after alleging that a minister broke a promise regarding the Ladakh region. Wangchuk claimed that despite assurances, the administration did not take steps to address his demands concerning the protection of Ladakh's environment and its people's rights. He stated that he was forced to end the strike due to deteriorating health, but vowed to continue the movement through other means. The specific minister and the exact nature of the broken promise were not detailed in the provided coverage.
